messages.subject: Hartwell v Cryovance - draft directions ahead of CMC
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Whitlock,

Ahead of the CMC on 8 May, please find our directions letter and draft directions attached. We propose disclosure by 26 June (including the vehicle, driver, route, tachograph and CAPA records), witness statements by 28 August, and exchange of GDP cold-chain expert reports by 16 October, with a five-day trial in a January 2027 window. We also invite your client to confirm whether it will seek a preliminary issue on clause 11.3.

Yours faithfully,
Tom Gallagher

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
